newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC SHARES FIRM IN FALLING SWISS MARKET.
newsitem.headline: SBC SHARES FIRM IN FALLING SWISS MARKET.

text.p: Shares in Swiss Bank Corp. (SBC) resisted the downward drag from other Swiss stock and opened slightly firmer after reporting an 84 percent rise in first half profit.
SBC's result, which was better than expected by analysts, was also higher than the 70 percent jump seen at Credit Suisse Group Group and the 67 percent rise at Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS).
At 0810 GMT, SBC's registered shares were up two francs, or 0.48 percent at 418 francs, while the blue-chip SMI index was down 1.17 percent.
In pre-bourse trading SBC had initially gained on the result, but then slipped below yesterday's close as Swiss shares were pulled down on losses on Wall Street overnight.
